title: Compose a second chant-driven Big Beat score
description: Create, render, measure, and present a second Big Beat score with a distinct chant hook and break from Call the Floor.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Built Hammer Time: a 124 BPM Big Beat score where all vocal material is chopped from one Hammer Song loop into four pads; no intact loop plays. Main audition measured objective_v2 106.50 with no v2 guard violations. Final local render is in renders/hammer-time-final.
